case.title: EM monotonicity conditions
case.question: Under what conditions does the EM algorithm guarantee that the likelihood does not decrease?
case.notes: The guarantee is conditional. Retrieving the claim without its conditions is the scope-inversion failure the week note flagged as the dangerous one, because nothing in the output looks wrong.
